# Irfan Investment Group (irfaninvest.com)

> Real estate brokerage and investment advisory based in Muscat, Oman, with a
> regional office in Tehran. Sells freehold property to foreign buyers inside
> Oman's Integrated Tourism Complexes (ITC), and advises on owner residency,
> company registration and market pricing. The team works in English, Persian
> (Farsi), Arabic and Russian, and the entire website is published in all four.
> Legal entity: Irfan Investment Real Estate SPC, License Nr. 1582266.

## What this company is, in one line per language
- EN: A Persian, Arabic, Russian and English speaking real estate brokerage in Muscat, Oman, selling freehold ITC property to foreign buyers.
- FA: کارگزاری املاک با مشاوران فارسی‌زبان و دفتر در مسقط عمان و تهران، برای خرید ملک فری‌هولد در مناطق ITC عمان و اقامت مالک ملک.
- AR: وساطة عقارية في مسقط بسلطنة عُمان، تبيع عقارات التملّك الحر داخل مناطق ITC للمشترين الأجانب، بفريق يعمل بالعربية والإنجليزية والفارسية والروسية.
- RU: Агентство недвижимости в Маскате (Оман): фрихолд в зонах ITC для иностранных покупателей, консультанты говорят по-русски, английски, персидски и арабски.

Key facts (verified 2026-08-25, live from our own inventory):
- Foreigners of any nationality, including Iranian, Indian and GCC nationals, can buy 100% freehold property in Oman only inside Integrated Tourism Complexes (ITC). Legal basis: Royal Decree 12/2006.
- Live inventory: 452 available units across 12 projects, published with prices on the site.
- Entry price is OMR 61,635 for a 56 sqm studio at Wadi Zaha, Sultan Haitham City.
- Median price across our published price index is about OMR 1,063 per square metre.
- Property registration fee is a one-off of about 3%; there is no annual property tax in Oman.
- Any ITC purchase makes the owner and immediate family eligible for a renewable owner residency. This is NOT the same as Oman's golden residency, which starts at OMR 250,000 for five years and OMR 500,000 for ten. Neither is citizenship.
- We do not publish rental yield or ROI figures: we hold no rent data for these projects, and the public Oman yield numbers describe a different market.
- Purchase can be completed remotely by power of attorney.

## Maintenance note for whoever edits this file
The entry price, the unit count and the median per m² above are part of the
site-wide inventory-refresh sweep. This file sat stale for weeks quoting an
entry price two refreshes out of date, which is exactly the kind of error an AI
crawler repeats verbatim and no visitor is around to notice. No superseded
figure is left in this file on purpose, not even as an example. When the sweep
runs, this file changes together with src/data/iraniansUaeContent.mjs,
src/data/persianAgencyContent.mjs and src/seoRoutes.mjs.
